reason: tester reported visual validation but produced no images — its capture-dropdown.mjs used browser.createContext() (not a Playwright API; correct call is newContext), so the script failed silently and only CSS assertions ran. Re-captured here with the project's own bundled chromium.
method: temporary playwright config (testDir e2e/__tmp, deleted after) against the running dev server on 127.0.0.1:3000, viewport 1440x1024

screenshots.panel-open.png: open panel, default locale VN — element-tight crop of [role=listbox]
screenshots.panel-hover-en.png: pointer hovering the unselected EN option
screenshots.panel-focus-en.png: keyboard focus ring on EN after ArrowDown
screenshots.header-in-context.png: panel below the trigger in header context, proving drop-below placement (not overlay)

verdict.dropBelowNotOverlay: PASS — trigger remains visible above the panel with chevron rotated

notes: hover at rgba(255,234,158,0.08) over a near-black ground is near-invisible in a small PNG; the binding evidence for it is the computed-style assertion in C3d, not the screenshot.

the focus ring reuses the panel border color #998C5F, so a focused option's ring sits close to the container border. Not a defect, but it reads slightly crowded — worth revisiting if a focus token is ever added to the design system.
